criteria.text: Generate a cryptographically random PKCE verifier and its unpadded base64url SHA-256 challenge.
criteria.test_id: post-m1-auth-c1: PKCE generation matches the Flutter verifier and S256 challenge shape

criteria.text: Build the exact Flutter Google authorization URL with the same endpoint, ordered scopes, PKCE, state, offline access, consent prompt, and granted-scope parameters.
criteria.test_id: post-m1-auth-c2: authorization URL exactly matches the Flutter desktop contract

criteria.text: Reject a Google loopback callback whose state does not match the generated state.
criteria.test_id: post-m1-auth-c3: a state mismatch is rejected

criteria.text: Reject a Google loopback callback containing an error parameter.
criteria.test_id: post-m1-auth-c4: an OAuth error parameter is rejected before other callback fields

criteria.text: Reject a Google loopback callback with a missing or empty authorization code.
criteria.test_id: post-m1-auth-c5: missing and empty authorization codes are rejected

criteria.text: Time out after five minutes while awaiting the callback and always close the loopback server.
criteria.test_id: post-m1-auth-c6: callback waiting uses the Flutter five-minute timeout

criteria.text: POST the authorization code, code verifier, and redirect URI to /auth/google/desktop-exchange and accept only a 200 { sessionToken, user } response.
criteria.test_id: post-m1-auth-c7: desktop exchange request body matches Flutter exactly

criteria.text: Bind the loopback listener to 127.0.0.1 on an OS-assigned port and open the authorization URL through Electron shell.openExternal.
criteria.test_id: post-m1-auth-c8: Electron host owns loopback binding and external-browser launch

criteria.text: In live mode, use the returned sessionToken as the runtime gateway bearer; when absent show a signed-out Google sign-in affordance and never fixture application data. Preserve VITE_RHYTHM_LIVE_TOKEN as a TEST-ONLY override.
criteria.test_id: post-m1-auth-c9: tokenless live mode is signed out rather than fixture-backed

criteria.text: Complete a real Google consent round trip with the production desktop OAuth client and verify the resulting account session in the packaged Electron app.
criteria.reason: UNVERIFIED: requires real Google consent and a packaged GUI launch; both are explicitly prohibited in this implementation unit.
